scope: Native versus zero-offset staged actual Canvas RGBA equality, genuine private finalization/domain, conflict observations and narrow replay guards. Not visual acceptance, full 34 regressions, performance, Gaussian preclip support or full multiface qualification.
comparisonScope: Cfalse native versus Ctrue staged using the same new source. Not actual full f828 baseline pixels; f828 source no-op and pure call equality are separate evidence.
dependencyReuse: Existing main lock-installed dev/browser launcher and mcp Playwright; no install or shared write.
